name: Cottonwood pipeline resource-SSOT + debt decommission (cot_bronze_ingest DataMining REST -> cot served, firm-separated)
description: Sub-project 3 of 3 of NFRA_PIPELINE (CTO PRD c925611f0, Andrew-direct 2026-07-02). Walk the Cottonwood partner pipeline END-TO-END -- first resource (the EventBridge trigger) through cot_bronze_ingest (DataMining REST) -> silver -> gold (snapshot-first) -> platinum -> the cot served surface -> portal -- with /seams + /molecule + /code-review, to establish the ABSOLUTE-TRUTH resource manifest (SSOT), then decommission every deprecated/floating/un-Terraform'd resource and make the cot Terraform rock-solid + applied (live==TF==applied, 0-drift). ORTHOGONAL to ADVI_COTETL (that = data-correct + the durable gateway auth; this = resource-truth + estate hygiene); the /seams+/molecule pass ALSO independently re-verifies the cot ETLFIX work. STRICTLY firm-separated -- opal-data-cot is a COMPLETELY separate firm pipeline from bd, NEVER mirrored/synced/coupled (gate + IAM Deny enforced, Rule 13); the manifest + decommission are cot-scoped only. Method + deliverables + ACs: NFRA_PIPELINE_PRD.md sections 2/4/7.
